title: Book Two · Chapter 1: The Word on the Page
story:
Ronan keeps a finger on the little piece of paper.

He is outside the classroom. The book is open against his school bag. On the page, a narrow bridge crosses a river.

Leo comes up beside him.

“Is there a bike in that book?”

“Yes. It is on the next page.”

“Is it blue?”

“Wait. I am still on the bridge page.”

Leo looks over his shoulder. “Then you are reading the wrong page.”

Ronan almost turns it. Instead, he shows Leo the word under the bridge.

“Can you read this?”

Leo looks at the letters. “Not that one.”

The bell rings. They go inside.

Miss Wu puts her books on the desk. Ronan waits until she finishes speaking to another child. Then he brings his book to her.

“This word,” he says. “Dad does not know it either.”

Miss Wu looks at the page.

“Bridge,” she says in English.

She says it again, slowly. Ronan tries the sound. The sound is new to him.

Miss Wu points to the picture.

“The water is here. The road goes over it. People can walk across the bridge.”

Ronan puts a finger on the little road.

“Like the one near the market?”

“Yes.”

He tries the English word once more.

“Good. Now look at these two pictures,” she says.

There is a boat beside one bridge. Beside the other, two people stand under a tree.

“Which picture has the boat?”

Ronan points at once.

“The first.”

“Is the boat moving?”

He looks again. There is no line behind the boat. A rope runs from it to the bank.

“Perhaps it is not moving.”

“That is possible. We cannot see everything in this picture.”

Miss Wu closes her own book. Another child is waiting with a broken pencil.

Ronan takes his book back to the desk. He writes the English word on the paper. Below it he draws a small bridge.

Leo leans over.

“Now you can teach your dad.”

“I can show him the word.”

“That is teaching.”

“Only one word.”

Leo makes a bridge with two pencils. His third pencil rolls off them.

“A very bad bridge,” Ronan says.

“It needs your dad.”

They both laugh. Miss Wu looks over, and they put the pencils away.

After school, Ronan walks home with the book under his arm. At the gate, he finds Dad cleaning the blue bike's back wheel. A little mud is stuck near the edge.

Ronan opens the book.

“Bridge,” he says.

Dad looks at the letters. Then he looks at the drawing.

“Show me again.”

Ronan says the word slowly. Dad tries it too.

From the kitchen, Mum calls them for food.

Dad leaves the cloth by the wheel. Ronan puts the paper back in his book.

“Do you want to read the next page?” Dad asks.

Ronan looks at the small bike there.

“Yes. But I do not know all the words yet.”

They take the book inside. Mum moves a bowl to make room for it on the table.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

bridge＝桥；across＝从一边到另一边；bank＝河岸；possible＝有可能的。

## 理解问题

1. Miss Wu怎样帮助Ronan理解那个词？
2. Dad听到这个词后怎样回应？

## 读句子

Ronan / puts the paper back / in his book.＝Ronan／把纸放回／书里。
